source_artifact.content_excerpt: This program is running on a hand-built pipeline — 12-theme grounding, ~72 Opus frame agents, 6 blind Fable novelty hunters, gap synthesis reading the merged pool, a basis-type contract ('ideas without a supporting basis are killed'), concurrency-capped batching, and an anti-anchoring rule (hunters run blind, only gap-synthesis reads the pool). None of it lives in saga:ideate; it lives in two dated plan docs for a bespoke workflow, and will evaporate once this backlog ships. No pool idea proposes capturing it: 17 /ideate-adjacent hits are all engine-lane offers into /ideate, not upgrades to /ideate's own architecture. idea: promote the proven elements into /ideate as declared modes — a grounding-brief stage, a basis_type contract on every emitted idea, an optional blind-hunter lane, a terminal gap-synthesis pass, and cap-aware batch dispatch — so the next big divergence run is an invocation, not a two-day pipeline build.
source_artifact.title: Fold this ideation program's architecture back into /ideate: blind hunters, gap synthesis, basis contract, and capped batching as reusable skill machinery
